request: Merge native titlebar with slimmer tab header; icon-only Atsumi branding; browser history, persistent sign-in and password saving plus ordinary browser basics.

audit.inaccessible: Carry forward previously recorded unavailable/deleted sources; no claim to read them.

decisions: Separate browser only: no changes to main app, recording/download queues, global routes/DNS/proxy, country credentials or other chats changes.
Remove OS decorations; 38px tab header with icon-only brand, blank-area drag/double-click maximize and fixed window buttons; retain resize and accessible names.
Local bounded indexed history and bookmarks on a dedicated background worker; search/pagination, open, remove and explicit clear confirmation. No remote synchronization.

Keep same dedicated WebView2 web-profile. Enable built-in password save prompts and form autofill; no DOM credential capture, app-owned password vault, or copying other browser logins. Site cookie expiry/sign-out remain authoritative.
Remember open and active tabs, recent closed tabs; support Ctrl+H/Ctrl+D/Ctrl+Shift+T. Maintain existing shortcuts, VPN fail-closed routing and download locks.
Preserve minimum 14px content text, existing Ink palette and concise labeled controls. Native pages hidden behind browser-owned panels.
Verify synthetic local data and native browser only; no real password reading, account changes, actual user history deletion, publishing or release.

Existing same-profile WebView2 History contains 74 visits. Import its bounded public-URL history once on the library worker through SQLite READ_ONLY/query_only; preserve the original database and never inspect Login Data or cookie values.
acceptance: History ordering/search/pagination/deletion and migration corruption tests; no UI-thread DB work
Header/window buttons/shortcuts/settings/country regression tests; responsive rendered layouts
Native slim titlebar drag/maximize/restore, history/bookmarks/reopen and persisted session across restart
Engine password save/autofill flags and isolated fake credential/session fixture; report unsupported or unverified prompts honestly
Frontend type/build, native tests/build; original profiles preserved
